summary: Onar Holding Corp filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing that effective October 1, 2026 it appointed Audit Committee Chair Kelly Anderson as Interim CFO under an interim services agreement with CXO Executive Solutions, which she founded, dated September 30, 2026. Compensation includes $20,000 monthly cash plus $12,000 monthly in preferred shares, a $50,000 audit-completion bonus tied to the Advertise Purple acquisition, and a $100,000 uplisting bonus. Anderson resigned from the board and as audit chair; Howard Palefsky succeeds her. Termination requires ten days' notice; a 30% placement fee applies if she is hired within twelve months. Watch governance independence and audit timing.
